content.short: Waya Collective is a decentralized industrial network aimed at disrupting the fashion industry in Africa.
content.description: Waya Collective is a decentralized project on Cardano dedicated to revolutionizing the industrial and fashion sectors in Africa. By utilizing blockchain technology to tokenize production chains, the project ensures transparency, fair wages, and ethical standards for African artisans and manufacturers. The $WYA governance token allows community members to influence the direction of the collective and participate in the liquidity protocol, which provides capital access for local factories. Waya Collective aims to build a resilient and sustainable industrial ecosystem for the future.
